verses.text: Scham wal he k'anab'ajan masanil cheknab'il swalkanel tik t'ayex, yik wach' ol ex elk'ochok, ol te k'ib' he b'isul, ol eyikejkan lum lum yak'nak sti' Jehová yak'an t'a heb' ko mam kicham.
Naekkot sik'lab'il, 40 ab'il onh ek' t'a takinh lu'um yuj Jehová ko Diosal. Ix yak'an ko yahelal, onh yak'an prowal yik syila' tato sko k'anab'ajej scheknab'il, mato ma'ay.

Ix kil syahelal yet' wejel yuj Jehová. Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'an maná ko waelok, juntzanh wa'el to manh kojtakok, manh yojtakokpax heb' ko mam kicham. Icha chi' ix onh yutej yik wach' skojtakejeli to manh yujoknhej tas waji ay ko k 'inal, palta to yuj masanil tas syal Jehová.
Ha ko pichul ix ko k'an t'a 40 ab'il chi', maj lajwiel-laj, maj malk'elaj kok ko b'eyi.
Naek wal to icha junok uninab'il skachji yuj smam, icha chi' ix onh yutejpax Jehová.
Yuj chi' yowalil tze k'anab'ajej scheknab'il Jehová, ochanhek tzak'an yuj, ayokab' yelk'och t'a yol he sat.
Yujto a Jehová ko Diosal wan ex yik'anb'at t'a sat lum lum manhxo jantakok swach'il, ay ha ha' ay sjaj yet' ha ha' skot t'a lum niwak witz.
Ha t'a lum lum chi', te wach' tz'aj ixim trigo, ixim cebada, te' uwa, te' higo, te' granado yet' te' olivo. Te ay pax nok' yal chab'.
Ayik ayexxo ek' t'a sat lu'um chi', manhxalaj tas tze na' yuj he wa'el yet' junokxo tasi. Ha t'a skal k'e'en k'e'en ay ta', ay k'e'en hierro, haxo t'a lum witz ay k'e'en cobre.
Wach' ol ex wa ta', yowalil ol eyak' yuj diosal t'a Jehová yujto wach' lum lum ol yak' chi' t'ayex.
Tze yil wal he b'a, mokab' b'at Jehová ko Diosal satk'olal eyu'uj. Yowalil tze k'anab'ajej scheknab'il, sk'ayb'ub'al yet' skachnab'il swalkanel tik t'ayex.
Ayik wach' ol ex waok, ol eyuk'an ha', kajanexxopax t'a he pat te wach', haxo talaj tz'aji sb'at Jehová satk'olal eyu'uj.
Hanhejtona' ayik ol te k'ib' sb'isul nok' he wakax, nok' he kalnel, ayik te ayxo k'e'en plata yet' k'e'en oro t'ayex yet' jantakxo tastak,
haxo talaj tz'aji tzeyik'ancha'anh he b'a, sb'atkan Jehová ko Diosal satk'olal eyu'uj, haton jun ik'annak onh elta t'a Egipto b'aj ayonh och chekab'ok.
Ha Jehová chi' ix onh kuchb'an t'a jun niwan tzinan lum te ay smay, b'aj ay nok' chan te ow yet' nok' sina'an, b'aj malaj ha ha', palta a ix ik'anelta ha ha' t'a sat k'e'en k'e'en yik skuk'ani.
Ix yak'an maná ko wa t'a tzinan lu'um chi', jun wa'el to manh yojtakok heb' ko mam kicham. Ix yak'och yahelal t'a kib'anh, ix onh yak'an prowal, yik wach' wach'xonhej tzonh elk'och yuj.
Ek'talaj t'a he pensar he na'an icha tik: Ha jantak ko b'eyumal tik, a yet' wal ko munlajel yet' kip ix kik'a', xe chi talaj.
Palta naek wal to a Jehová ko Diosal tz'ak'an he na' yet' eyip yik syal eyoch b'eyumal, yik wach' tz'elk'och strato yak'nak yet' heb' ko mam kicham ichaton wan kilan tikne'ik.

Palta tato ol b'at Jehová ko Diosal satk'olal eyuj jun, tato ol ex och tzak'an t'a spatik juntzanh komon Dios, ol eyak'anem he b'a t'ay yet' eyem nhojan ejmelal t'ay. Tato icha chi' ol he k'ulej, a in swalkan t'ayex tikne'ik, ol ex satjokel yuj Jehová chi'.
Icha wal ol aj satel juntzanh chonhab' b'aj wan eyik'jib'at chi' yuj, icha wal chi' ol aj he satel yuj tato manh ol he k'anab'ajej tas syala'.
